private_deposits.title: Private Deposits
private_deposits.description: Transform your tokens into private notes using zero-knowledge proofs. Your deposits become completely anonymous and untraceable, ensuring maximum financial privacy on StarkNet.
how_it_works: Connect your StarkNet wallet to the privacy pool
Select the token and amount you want to deposit
Receive a cryptographic note representing your deposit
Your deposit is now completely private and anonymous
use_cases: Protect your financial privacy from competitors
Secure large transactions from public scrutiny
Create private reserves for future use

anonymous_withdrawals.title: Anonymous Withdrawals
anonymous_withdrawals.description: Withdraw your funds to any address without revealing the connection to your original deposit. Using zero-knowledge proofs, prove ownership without exposing your identity or transaction history.
how_it_works: Select your private note from your deposits
Enter any withdrawal address (can be different from deposit)
Generate zero-knowledge proof of ownership
Complete anonymous withdrawal with full privacy
use_cases: Withdraw to fresh addresses for maximum privacy

private_note_transfers.title: Private Note Transfers
private_note_transfers.description: Transfer funds between private notes within the pool without revealing sender, recipient, or amount. Enable completely private peer-to-peer transactions using cryptographic notes.
how_it_works: Select your source private note
Enter the recipient's note hash
Specify transfer amount (can be partial)
Execute private transfer with zero-knowledge proof

deposit_merging.title: Deposit Merging
deposit_merging.description: Combine multiple small deposits into a single larger note for improved privacy and gas efficiency. Merge notes of the same token to optimize your privacy set and reduce transaction costs.
how_it_works: Select multiple notes of the same token
Verify combined amount and fees
Generate zero-knowledge proof for merge
Receive single consolidated private note
use_cases: Optimize gas costs for future transactions
Improve privacy by increasing note size

private_token_swaps.title: Private Token Swaps
private_token_swaps.description: Exchange one token for another while maintaining complete privacy. Swap tokens through integrated DEX protocols without revealing your trading activity or balances to the public.
how_it_works: Select source token from your private notes
Choose destination token and amount
Get price quote from integrated DEX
Execute private swap with zero-knowledge proof
